tool_suggestions.title: Team Collaboration Feedback Dashboard
tool_suggestions.prompt: Create a dashboard to analyze team collaboration efficiency using comment activity and file interactions.
features: View top collaborators by comments and contributions.
Analyze comment activity patterns over time.
Access detailed interaction histories per team.
Filter feedback by project or file.

tool_suggestions.title: Project Health and Status Monitor
tool_suggestions.prompt: Develop a tool to track and assess the health and status of ongoing projects, using data from file revisions and team activity.
features: Display current status and last update time for projects.
Visualize recent file revisions and activity logs.
Generate alerts for projects with stagnating updates.
Filter projects by team and progress stage.

tool_suggestions.title: User Activity & Engagement Insight Tool
tool_suggestions.prompt: Build a tool to provide insights into user activity and engagement by analyzing login trends and access histories.
features: View user login frequency and last active times.
Identify users with decreased activity over time.
Filter data by user roles and teams for detailed insights.
